target_object.anchors: c in L, f in R, with cz and zf edges.
target_object.ports: P_L subseteq L\{c}, P_R subseteq R\{f}.
exact_channel_interface: All L-R edges are exactly X=E(L,R), with X subseteq P_L x P_R.
No restriction is imposed on internal edges of G[L], G[R], or on additional z-L/z-R adjacencies.

canonical_ports_lemma.statement: Whenever an exact-channel decomposition exists for a fixed partition L/R, there is one with canonical minimal ports equal to the endpoints of crossing edges.

formulae.P_L_star: {u in L : N(u) intersect R is nonempty}
formulae.P_R_star: {v in R : N(v) intersect L is nonempty}

canonical_ports_lemma.reason: Any non-boundary port can be deleted from P_L or P_R without changing X or violating completeness. Thus ports never need to be guessed during recognition.

fixed_triple_2SAT_reduction.fixed_data: Choose distinct ordered vertices (z,c,f) with cz,zf in E(G).
fixed_triple_2SAT_reduction.variables: For every v != z, Boolean x_v; x_v=0 means v in L and x_v=1 means v in R.
unary_forces: For every v in N(c)\{z}, force x_v=0.
For every v in N(f)\{z}, force x_v=1.

edge_clauses.convention: For every undirected edge uv in E(G-z), process the ordered endpoint names u,v exactly as stored; both crossing orientations are constrained.

forbid_LR.bad_condition: If cu is not an edge OR fv is not an edge, the assignment x_u=0,x_v=1 is forbidden.

forbid_RL.bad_condition: If fu is not an edge OR cv is not an edge, the assignment x_u=1,x_v=0 is forbidden.

fixed_triple_2SAT_reduction.size: O(n+m) variables/clauses for a fixed triple after adjacency lookup preprocessing.

forward_2SAT_to_decomposition: Let a satisfying assignment define L={v!=z:x_v=0} and R={v!=z:x_v=1}. Unary clauses put c in L and f in R.
The forced neighborhoods ensure no edge from c crosses to R and no edge from f crosses to L, so c is not a canonical left port and f is not a canonical right port.
Define canonical P_L and P_R as endpoints of crossing edges and X=E(L,R).
For every crossing edge uv with u in L,v in R, the relevant forbidden-orientation clause can be satisfied only if cu and fv are both edges.
Hence c is complete to every canonical left port and f is complete to every canonical right port.
By construction every L-R edge is exactly an edge of X subseteq P_L x P_R.
Therefore the assignment yields a valid exact-channel decomposition.
reverse_decomposition_to_2SAT: Take any valid exact-channel decomposition for the fixed triple and assign x_v by its L/R side.
Because c is not in P_L and f is not in P_R, no neighbor of c other than z lies in R and no neighbor of f other than z lies in L; all unary forces hold.
For any edge uv in G-z crossing from L to R, exact-channel validity gives cu and fv; therefore the LR orientation is never forbidden.
The symmetric argument handles an R-to-L crossing orientation.
Edges whose endpoints lie on the same side satisfy both binary clauses automatically.
Thus every valid decomposition yields a satisfying 2-SAT assignment.
exact_equivalence.theorem: For fixed distinct (z,c,f) with cz,zf in E(G), an exact-channel decomposition exists iff the constructed 2-SAT instance is satisfiable.

algorithm: Enumerate every ordered triple of distinct vertices (z,c,f) with cz and zf edges.
On the first SAT instance, output (z,c,f), the L/R assignment, canonical P_L/P_R, and X=E(L,R).
If every eligible triple is UNSAT, report that no exact-channel decomposition exists.
global_discovery_algorithm.refined_triple_count: Only triples with c,f in N(z), c!=f are eligible; their number is sum_z d(z)(d(z)-1) <= 2m*Delta <= O(nm).
global_discovery_algorithm.refined_complexity: O(nm(n+m)) with O(1) adjacency queries after polynomial preprocessing; the coarse O(n^3(n+m)) bound is always sufficient.

positive_certificate: direct verification c complete to P_L
direct verification f complete to P_R
direct verification c notin P_L and f notin P_R
direct verification all crossing edges are exactly X subseteq P_L x P_R
negative_certificate: For every eligible ordered triple (z,c,f), a 2-SAT UNSAT certificate.
A standard proof-carrying UNSAT witness is a variable x_v such that x_v and NOT x_v lie in the same implication-graph SCC, optionally with explicit implication paths both ways.
proof_carrying_output.verification_complexity: Polynomial in the graph size and total certificate size.

exhaustive_small_graph_sanity_check.method: Enumerated every simple graph, every ordered distinct triple (z,c,f), and every direct L/R partition; compared direct-definition existence with the 2-SAT criterion.
exhaustive_small_graph_sanity_check.authority: SANITY_CHECK_ONLY; theorem authority is the analytic iff proof above.

application_firewall.rule: Additional C11/P7/source-role restrictions must be separately encoded and analyzed. Graph-only unary filters on candidate triples/vertices preserve polynomiality by candidate filtering, but arbitrary extra semantic constraints may not.
application_firewall.forbidden_inference: Do not infer polynomial discovery for a stronger future application contract merely because the pure exact-channel interface is polynomially recognizable.

contract_consequences.LOCAL_FORMULA_CERTIFIED: YES once a decomposition is returned, by the abstract exact-local channel theorem.
contract_consequences.LOCAL_TO_GLOBAL_TRANSFER_CERTIFIED: Polynomially decidable once a decomposition is returned, by computing nu(X), using the explicit upper cut, and independently computing exact vertex connectivity.
